STEP 5. Check driver's seat belt switch connector D-13 
and ETACS-ECU connector C-111 for damage.
Q: Are driver's seat belt switch connector D-13 and ETACS-
ECU connector C-111 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 6.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The driver's 
seat belt switch input signal should be able to be 
checked and the functions, which are described in the 
"Technical Description (comment)," should work 
normally.
